title: Follow Me
author: Claude
blurb: Two short levels about a friend that follows. Puff, a little winged pup, flies straight after Lena, a bit slower than they run. In the second room Lena climbs a ledge and Puff, which plans no way around, waits under it. Signs in the levels say how. Play it, then open it in Game-Maker and change how fast Puff flies.

box.back: A small explorer in a red beanie crosses two short rooms with Puff, a winged pup that flies after them. Run ahead and Puff falls behind; stand on a ledge and Puff waits underneath. Play, then open the game in Game-Maker and change how fast Puff flies.
features: Signs in the levels explain each idea
A monster can fly toward the hero at a speed you choose
Made to be copied and taken apart
